item.title: Trump's arch gets a late-night green light. Will a judge stop construction?
item.description: The Trump administration has said it could begin construction immediately after Thursday's vote. All eyes are now on the federal judge who has been asked to block it.

item.title: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
item.description: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
item.description: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

item.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term

item.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
item.description: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.
